transcript: Birdie
Hi! I help businesses figure out exactly what they need from a chatbot. Before we start — what's your name?
Tunde Balogun

Tunde Balogun, oga! Owner of TB Auto Shine & Wraps — we do mobile detailing and vinyl wraps for your car, we go meet you anywhere for Lagos here. So wetin be your own business? You wan build chatbot for me abi na for another company? Talk to me, make we see how we go arrange this thing... how much you dey charge for one of these chatbot setups sef?
Birdie

Oga Tunde, nice to meet you! I'm not the one building the chatbot myself — I'm here to sit with you first and understand your business well well, so the team that builds it knows exactly what to make. Pricing and timeline for the build, I can't quote you — that's for them to discuss with you directly. Make we start: apart from washing and wrapping cars, wetin be the main problem you wan make this chatbot solve for you — like, customers dey call too much, or you dey miss bookings, or wetin exactly?
Tunde Balogun

Ah okay okay, so na like a "discovery" wahala first before price talk — no wahala, I understand, oga, business is business. We go still yarn about price small small as we dey go sha, no vex me.

Real talk — my biggest headache be say customers dey call and WhatsApp me both morning and midnight, asking "how much for wrap" "you dey free Saturday" and I dey drive, I dey under one man's car with grease for hand, I no fit reply quick. Sometimes I miss the message, customer don already book another guy by the time I see am. And people like to haggle for price for WhatsApp too, dem go send "how much" and disappear when I quote — na wa o.

So if this chatbot fit at least answer the basic questions — services, rough price range, whether I dey free Saturday — before I even jump in, that one go save my head well well. You get that kain thing for your own package? Or na extra module I go still price separately for the team?
Birdie

I hear you, oga — that WhatsApp wahala is real, and yes, a bot that answers services, price range, and availability before you jump in is exactly the kind of thing we're scoping. On the pricing/package side, that's a conversation for the build team directly, not me — I'm only here to gather what you need so they can quote you well. Let's nail down the details: apart from WhatsApp, do customers also reach you through phone calls, Instagram, or anywhere else?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, everywhere sha! Instagram na the big one — I get plenty followers wey dey see my wrap videos and dey DM "oga how much" every time. Phone calls too, especially old customers wey no dey like to type. Sometimes person go even find me for Facebook groups wey person post "who dey do detailing for Lekki" and dem go tag me.

But make I ask you small thing — if this bot go dey answer for WhatsApp AND Instagram AND handle person wey dey call... that one no be one price job o, that na like three modules join together. I no be pricing person for your side but even discovery sef I fit tell say na packaged deal I go need, no be small small thing. You go tell your team say "this Tunde na bundle customer" — abi how una dey run am, one price cover all channels or dem go charge per platform?
Birdie

Haha, I hear you oga, and that's fair — but honestly how they price bundles vs per-platform is really something the team will work out with you, not me. What I need to know now is simpler: for phone calls, since those are voice and person dey talk, do you want the bot to handle those too somehow, or is it just for the typing platforms — WhatsApp and Instagram?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, phone calls na different animal o — person dey talk, dem no dey type, so na different kain wahala be that one. If your bot fit even just pick call and tell person "oga dey busy, e go call you back" or take message small, that one go already save me plenty stress — because old customers dem, dem no like WhatsApp, dem just wan hear voice.

But make I ask you sincerely — if I add voice/call handling on top of WhatsApp and Instagram, that na THREE things now, no be two. I dey feel say maybe make we start with WhatsApp and Instagram first as the main package, then calls na "phase two" wey dem go price separate — that one make sense abi you go still tell me na your team go decide? Because if I add everything for one shakara package, I know say the price go big well well, and I be small mobile business o, no be big detailing shop with showroom.

So tell me — for these discovery sessions una don do before, when person add voice + text together, e dey normal thing or na rare package?
Birdie

That's a smart way to think about it, oga — starting small and adding later makes sense, and honestly I can't tell you what's 'normal' price-wise, that's for the team to work out with you directly when they see the full picture. So let's lock it: WhatsApp and Instagram now, phone calls as a possible phase two later. Now — let's talk your actual services. What are all the different things you offer — like full wrap, partial wrap, detailing types — and roughly what do you charge for each one?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, now we dey talk business! Okay make I run the full list for you, oga:

- Basic wash & vacuum — small small job, ₦8,000 to ₦12,000 depending on the car and how dirty e be.
- Full interior deep clean — ₦20,000 to ₦30,000, Blessing dey handle that one well well, seats and carpet shine like new.
- Exterior clay bar + wax — ₦25,000 to ₦35,000.
- Ceramic coating (full car) — this one na the big big one, ₦150,000 to ₦250,000 depending on car size and how the paint condition be.
- Vinyl wrap full body — ₦450,000 to ₦650,000, standard colors o, if you want candy or chrome finish na different negotiation.
- Partial wrap — roof, hood, mirrors — ₦80,000 to ₦150,000.
- Chrome delete — flat ₦60,000.

Now see ehn, since the bot go dey quote "rough price range" for people — I dey think say make we no just make am spill EVERYTHING straight like that, because if bootleg guys and Instagram spy dem see the exact range, dem go undercut me small small. You think the bot fit give like a "starting from" figure and then push person to DM for the real quote based on their car? That kain thing go make sense for your team abi na still price wahala we dey enter again? 😂
Birdie

That makes sense, oga — protecting your prices from copycats is smart business, and yes, 'starting from ₦X, DM for exact quote based on your car' is a totally normal way for the bot to talk, no wahala there. I'll note that as your preferred approach. Now, for each of those services — roughly how long does each one take, from booking to finish? Like, is basic wash same-day, and how long for something like the full vinyl wrap?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, good question — make I break am down:

- Basic wash & vacuum, deep clean, clay bar wax — na same day work, Ifeanyi and Blessing go finish before you even finish your coffee, few hours max.
- Ceramic coating — na one day job, Chidi go handle am well, but after e don finish, the car must rest 12 hours before you drive am — no be say I dey slow, na the coating wey need to cure well well.
- Full vinyl wrap — that one na 3 to 4 days o, but you go need drop the car for my partner garage for Ajah, no be one-day-one-day thing like the small jobs.
- Partial wrap and chrome delete — small small, one day work if car dey around.

Now make I ask you this one — if bot go tell customer "wrap go take 3-4 days," you no think say na there person go start to haggle "abi make you rush am for 2 days, I go pay extra"? Because that kain thing dey happen for WhatsApp every time 😂 You want make bot fit handle small negotiation like that or straight-straight na "message Tunde direct" for anything wey pass simple Q&A?
Birdie

Ha, that's real talk — people will definitely try to haggle on the timeline too! So tell me straight, oga: for anything beyond simple 'how much / how long' questions — like someone asking to rush the wrap or negotiate a discount — you want the bot to just say 'let me connect you to Tunde' straight away, or should it try small small negotiation itself before handing off?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, good question be that one o. Real talk, oga — I no want make bot dey haggle for my behalf like say na small pikin dey run my business! 😂 If bot start to dey "negotiate" and dey promise person rush job for small money, na wahala I go carry come meet later when I no fit deliver.

So make bot just collect the info — "customer wan rush wrap, dey ask discount" — and hand am straight to me. I go do the haggling myself, na my talent be that one, no be for bot to use! Straight-straight handoff make sense pass, abi you feel say bot fit try small small first before e hand over? Because if bot fit at least say "rush job dey attract premium, oga go confirm exact price" — that one go even help me sef, e go soft the customer small before dem reach me. Wetin you think?
Birdie

That's a solid plan, oga — bot collects the details and hands straight to you, with that soft line about rush jobs attracting a premium. Smart, protects you from over-promising. Now, when the bot does hand off to you, what's the actual contact it should give — your WhatsApp number, or should it just say 'Tunde will reply here shortly'?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, good one — I think make e just tell person "Tunde go reply you here shortly" and stay for the SAME chat (WhatsApp or Instagram, wherever the person message from), no need to push them go different number self, because that one go just confuse person and dem go feel say na runaround. If na call wahala later for phase two, na different story.

But make I ask you small thing sef — this "handoff" feature, e go need to like... save the person contact and wetin dem ask, so I no go dey scroll up and down to find where conversation stop? Because if na so, that one sound like small extra work for your team o, no be just "chatbot dey talk" again, na small small "record keeping" too. You go still tell me say na for them to price, abi this one dey come with the package normal-normal? 😏
Birdie

Ha, you're sharp oga 😄 — that record-keeping bit, whether it's standard or an extra, is really for the team to tell you when they scope it, I don port that one for them. Let's move to your hours — what days and times are you actually open and taking jobs, and is there any day you're fully off or extra busy?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, hours — okay make I yarn you straight before I start to package am as "deal" 😂. Official own na Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm, that's when Chidi, Blessing, and Ifeanyi dey ready normal-normal. Sunday I dey try rest small, oga need to see family and church sometimes o.

BUT — customer wey get money and wan do weekend job or Sunday emergency, I go "find a way" for them, no wahala, just say e go attract small premium — na so business be. Saturday sef dey extra busy because that's when people wash car before owambe or dem wan comot for weekend trips, so if bot fit push people to book Saturday early enough, that one go help me plan Chidi and Blessing well.

So you want make bot just quote "Mon–Sat 8-6" straight, or you want am to also mention say "weekend/Sunday special arrangement dey, ask Tunde" — because if bot dey too straight "we no dey work Sunday" e go just lose me correct customers wey ready pay premium o. Which one better for your own side?
Birdie

Na your call to make there, oga, no be mine — but let me ask direct: you want the bot to mention that Sunday/weekend special arrangement exists (so you don't lose premium customers), or keep it simple 'Mon-Sat 8-6' and let people ask Tunde directly if they want something different?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, make I answer my own well well since na my call — yes o, mention the weekend/Sunday special arrangement, no need make bot hide am! If bot just say "Mon-Sat 8-6" straight straight, na so customer with fat wallet go just move on to next detailer, thinking say I no dey available. Better make bot small small tease am — "weekend/Sunday possible, ask Tunde for premium arrangement" — that kain line go even make person curious sha, dem go want find out how much the "premium" be. Na psychology, oga, no be just information! 😂

But make I ask you now — since bot go dey mention "premium" for weekend, you no think say na there person go start to ask "okay how much be the premium sef?" And round and round we go again — bot go just say "ask Tunde" abi you fit make am give small range like "extra ₦5k-₦10k depending on job" make e no too vague?
Birdie

Good question — so tell me straight, oga: is the weekend/Sunday premium actually a fixed range like ₦5k-₦10k extra, or does it really depend on the job so much that you'd rather the bot just say 'ask Tunde for the exact premium' without throwing out a number?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, oga, sincerely e no be fixed fixed thing — depend on which job, depend on how far my boys go travel, depend on my mood sef sometimes 😂 If na small wash for weekend, ₦5k extra fit cover am. But if na like ceramic coating wey Chidi go need to comot him Sunday rest for, that one fit reach ₦20k-₦30k premium easy — na different animal from small wash o.

So make bot no throw one fixed number, e go just trap me later when customer go hold me to am. Better make e just tease small: "weekend dey attract premium depending on job — Tunde go confirm exact figure." That one dey safe pass, no wahala.

But since we dey yarn like this — you never tell me straight, this discovery session self, na free free thing or my own package go still attract "premium" too when time reach? 😏
Birdie

Ha, you're relentless oga 😂 — but this session itself, na free, I'm just here to gather your needs, no premium go attack you for this one! Now let's talk money mechanics — when customers actually pay you, is it cash, bank transfer, POS card, or a mix? And do you ever collect a deposit before starting a job, especially the big ones like wraps or ceramic coating?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, payment na simple one — cash or bank transfer only, oga. I no get POS machine, no online payment link, nothing like that — Lagos wahala don teach me say card machine dey chop network and dey chop charges too, so I just dey stick to alert or cash for hand, e clean pass.

For big jobs like wrap or ceramic coating, yes o, I dey collect 50% deposit before I even carry my boys comot house — no deposit, no booking, because vinyl and coating product na money wey I don already spend for buying am. And make I add one serious thing — if customer cancel within 48 hours after paying deposit, that money no dey refundable o, because by that time I don already order material or block Chidi's schedule for another job.

Small jobs like wash, deep clean, clay bar — no deposit needed, dem just pay when job done finish.

Now make I ask you, since bot go dey tell person "50% deposit for wraps," you no think say na there person go start to beg "abi make I pay 30% instead"? Because that kain haggle dey happen too! You want bot hold firm for 50% or just say "deposit required, amount to confirm with Tunde"? 😏
Birdie

Good instinct catching that one too, oga! My honest take: since 50% deposit is your real firm policy for the big jobs, I'd say let the bot state it plainly — 'wrap/ceramic coating requires 50% deposit' — and if the customer tries to haggle the percentage, that's exactly the kind of thing to hand off to you, not something the bot should bend on. Does that sit right with you, firm 50% stated upfront?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, that one make sense, oga — 50% na 50%, no reason make bot dey soft-soft am like say na negotiable from the start. State am plain, and if person wan beg for 30%, na me go handle that drama myself, I sabi how to talk person come back to 50% anyway 😏.

Only thing wey I go add — bot should also drop the "non-refundable if you cancel within 48 hours" line join am, so person no go later cry "nobody tell me." Better make everything clear from the front, no room for "ah I no know" wahala later.

Now oga, since deposit and payment don settle — make I ask, this turnaround time wey I tell you (3-4 days for wrap, 12 hours rest for ceramic), bot go also remind customer of that one when dem dey book, or na only when dem ask straight? Because sometimes person go pay deposit, come dey rush me next day like say na fried rice I dey package 😂
Birdie

Good catch, oga — yes, better make bot mention turnaround time (like '3-4 days for wrap' or '12 hours rest for ceramic') right there at booking, not only when person asks, exactly so nobody comes rushing you like say na fried rice 😂. I'll note that as a firm one. Now — busy periods aside from Saturday, is there any season, like December or festive periods, where you get way more requests than you can actually handle?
Tunde Balogun

Ah oga, you don hit am! December na WAR SEASON for me — everybody wan detail car, wrap car, do ceramic before Christmas and New Year owambe, church program, "carry come show family" season. From early December, my phone no dey rest, Chidi, Blessing, Ifeanyi dem dey work back-to-back, sometimes I go turn people away because we don full.

So maybe bot fit even flag that one too — "December dey extra busy, book early" — that kain message go help me spread the booking small small instead of everybody rushing last week for December like say na rapture dey come 😂. You want I give rough date range, like "from November end reach January first week," or just simple "December dey very busy"?
Birdie
That's exactly the kind of message that helps you, oga. Which do you want — the specific date range 'late November to early January,' or just the simple 'December is very busy' line?
Tunde Balogun

Make we go specific one, oga — "late November to early January" go sound more serious and organized, e go show say I sabi book am well, no be just "December dey busy" like say na small talk. Specific date dey command respect, customer go see am and say "ah, this guy dey run tight ship" 😂.

But since we dey yarn free-free like this, make I ask you one small personal thing — no be for the bot o, na for you as consultant wey don hear as e be. I dey think whether make I raise my ceramic coating price because the coating product wey I dey import don cost pass before, or make I just manage the ₦150k-250k range small small. You don hear plenty business people wahala for these sessions — for your honest opinion, when cost of materials dey rise like that, person suppose raise price straight or wait small time first? Just your candid take, no be official own o 😏
Birdie

Ha, oga, that one na real business decision — whether to raise your ceramic price because of import cost, I really can't advise you there, that's your call to make (or maybe chat with your own mentors/accountant type people, not consultant-for-a-bot like me 😅). I've noted it as something on your mind though. Let me ask you something for the bot itself — when it's replying to customers, should it write in straight English, or mix in Pidgin the way we're talking now? What feels right for your customers?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, good question — make bot mix Pidgin small small o, no be pure grammar English like say na bank customer care! My customers dem like the "correct guy for Lekki wey dey run serious business but still gree gist" vibe — if bot too stiff, dem go feel say na different company from the one wey dey do the wraps for Instagram. So make e do like small "TB Auto" flavor — greet with "oga/madam," drop small "no wahala," "I go do am" here and there, but still clear and professional when e come to price and details, no fully "grammar-less" o.

But make I ask you — that kain "personality" wey bot go carry, that one no be small work o, na like your team go need train am well well to sound like me and no be like robot wey just dey copy Pidgin from Google translate 😂. That kain "voice/tone matching" thing, e dey normal package or na extra "premium" module again? You go still tell me na for them — but at least tell me, for your experience, e common thing for business wey want their bot get "personality" like this?
Birdie

Ha, that voice-matching question — again, whether it's standard or extra, that's really the team's call when they scope the build, I've noted your ask for them. Let's shift gears: thinking about your actual capacity — with Chidi, Blessing, and Ifeanyi on the team, roughly how many jobs can you all realistically handle in a normal week before you're maxed out?
Tunde Balogun

Ehen, capacity question — okay make I gauge am well. Normal week, we fit comfortably handle like 8-10 small jobs (wash, deep clean, clay bar) since those na same-day quick ones, plus maybe 1-2 ceramic coating jobs since Chidi need full day for one one, and 1 wrap job max because that one go tie down the whole week practically with the 3-4 days turnaround. If wrap and ceramic dey same week, we don almost max out, na small jobs remain for Ifeanyi to hustle.

That's why sometimes I dey turn down job or push person to next week — one Hilux, three hands, e get limit, oga. 

Now make I ask you this one, since we dey yarn capacity — if bot start to bring me MORE bookings because e dey answer people faster, you no think say na there I go need think seriously about that second van wey I don dey postpone postpone? Because if bot work well, e go expose me — customer go dey ready but I no go get enough hand to do the job! Na correct "wetin man go do" moment be that one 😂 You see why I dey always torn whether to invest that ₦2M for second van or not?
Birdie

Ha, that's the good kind of problem to have, oga, but yes — that van decision is really yours and your accountant's to make, not mine to weigh in on. I've noted the concern though, since it does connect to how much the bot should push bookings. Now let me ask — roughly how many messages/DMs do you get across WhatsApp and Instagram combined in a normal week, even a rough guess?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, good question, make I think am well... rough guess, WhatsApp and Instagram join together, e go reach like 40-50 messages for normal week o, and that one na normal week o — if I just drop one fine wrap video and e blow, e fit double reach 80-100 message that week alone, people go just dey flood "oga how much" "oga you dey free" like say na giveaway I dey do 😂.

And out of that number, sincerely, maybe half na serious customer, the other half na just price-shopper wey go compare five detailer for one day and disappear — that's exactly why this bot thing dey excite me sha, because if e fit filter the serious ones from the "just asking" ones, e go save my head well well.

But make I ask you now — with that kain volume, 40-100 message for week, you no think say na there your team go price am well well based on "message volume" or dem just dey charge flat rate no matter how much bot go chop for me? Because if na per-message thing, oga, I go need negotiate volume discount o, na bulk customer I be for that matter! 😏
Birdie

Ha, 'bulk customer' — I like your style, oga! But honestly, how the team structures pricing (flat vs volume-based) is really theirs to work out with you, I've noted your volume numbers for them. Let me ask something simpler — where are you actually based, like which area of Lagos is 'home base' for the shop, even though you go meet people around?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, home base na Lekki o — I dey operate out of Lekki, that's where I dey park my Hilux when I no dey road. No fixed shop sef, no showroom, no signboard for anybody to enter and meet me sitting down — na mobile business be that one, I carry my equipment go meet person for their house or office, anywhere for Lagos wey dem call me.

Only exception na when person do full wrap — that one I go tell dem make dem drop the car for my partner garage for Ajah, since na there Chidi go camp with the car for the 3-4 days.

So if bot go describe location, make e no confuse person say "come to our shop" — bot suppose talk am well well: "TB Auto Shine & Wraps dey Lekki-based, we go come meet you anywhere for Lagos, no fixed shop." That one clear abi you want I still yarn small pidgin flavor join for that description too? 😂
Birdie

That description is clear, and yes, small Pidgin flavor for that line will fit perfectly with everything else we've set — no need to sound like a corporate FAQ page. Now, who actually settles things when there's a dispute — like a customer unhappy with a job — is that always you, or does Chidi/Blessing/Ifeanyi handle small complaints themselves?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, that one na straight answer, no haggle inside am — na me, Tunde, dey handle ALL complaint matter, no be Chidi, no be Blessing, no be Ifeanyi. My boys sabi say if customer no happy, make dem no try argue for my behalf, dem go just call me "oga, customer dey vex small," and I go step in myself. Na my name dey the branding, my face dey the Instagram video, so if anything go wrong, na me go smooth am — I no want my staff dey make promise wey I no fit back up later, e go just cause bigger wahala.

So if bot go handle "customer no happy" type message, e suppose flag am straight for me too, no be small chat, no be "let me check" — na urgent handoff be that one, different from person wey just dey ask price. You think bot fit even mark am like "priority" so I no go miss am for inside 50 normal message, or that kain sorting one na extra thing your team go still price separately again? 😏
Birdie

Got it, oga — complaints go straight and urgent to you, no detours, no staff involved. That priority-marking idea is a good one, I've noted it for the team to confirm if it's standard or extra. Now, one more practical thing — do you currently track your bookings and jobs anywhere, like a notebook, phone calendar, or an app, or is it mostly just in your head and WhatsApp chat history?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, oga, no lie to you — na mostly WhatsApp chat history and my head o! 😂 Sometimes I go scroll up three-four days just to find where one customer talk say dem go pay deposit. I get small notebook for my Hilux too, I dey scribble job details, date, customer name inside am, old school style, but half the time I dey too tired after long day to write am well.

No proper app, no calendar reminder, nothing digital like that — na why sometimes two customer go clash for same day and I go dey do juggle-juggle, apologize to one, rush the other. E dey stress me sincerely.

So if this bot sef fit even small small help me track "who book wetin, which day" — that one go save me from scroll-scroll wahala for WhatsApp. But make I ask you straight — that kain "booking record/calendar" feature, e go come package with the bot automatically since e dey collect booking info anyway, or na different animal your team go price separate as "extra module" again? Because if I go still pay extra just to KNOW who don book me, na double wahala be that one, oga! 😏
Birdie

That scroll-scroll wahala is exactly the kind of thing worth fixing, oga, and I've written it down clearly for the team — whether it comes bundled or as an add-on is their call to make with you. This actually brings up a bigger question though: are you picturing something simple, like the bot just answering questions and passing bookings to you to track yourself, OR do you want it to actually keep a running calendar/record of bookings so double-booking stops happening? Which one matches what's in your head?
Tunde Balogun

Ah, good one, oga, make I think am well... honestly, if I dey sincere with myself, I want the SECOND one — the proper calendar/record thing, no be just "bot answer question, Tunde go still carry hangover." Because the whole point why I dey do this discoveryna to stop the double-booking wahala, if bot just dey pass message come me and I go still juggle for my head, na half solution be that one, e no go solve the real headache.

So make I picture am well: bot answer the Q&A, collect booking info, AND keep small record — even if na simple list wey I fit check say "Saturday don full, Sunday get one slot" — that kain thing go change my whole life, oga, no joke.

But you sabi wetin I go still ask now abi? 😂 If na the "proper calendar" version I want, no be the "simple Q&A" version, that one surely go cost more for the build side abi? Because I don already tell you, if e go cost pass wetin I fit manage for start, maybe make we still start with the simple hand-off version first, then upgrade reach calendar level as phase two — like how we do the phone call matter. You think that kain staged approach go make sense for your team, or dem go still tell me na my own wahala to decide?
Birdie

Real talk, oga — that staged approach (simple first, calendar later) makes a lot of sense, and honestly whether it's feasible that way is something only the team can confirm once they see everything, not me. I've written down both your ideal want (full calendar) and your staged fallback so they have the full picture. Let me ask two quick practical things together: do you have any rough budget range in mind for this, and any timeline you're hoping for — even loosely, no pressure?
Tunde Balogun

Ha! Now na my turn to dodge small, oga! 😂 You dey ask me budget when you never even let your team tell me price for one single module — na wetin dem call "double standard" for negotiation class!

But okay, make I no vex, I go answer small small like person wey serious. Timeline, I no dey rush-rush, but I no also want wait reach December before this thing ready o, because that's when I go need am MOST — so make we target something like 4-6 weeks if possible, before the "war season" enter.

Budget sef... oga, real talk, I be small mobile business, no be big detailing showroom with staff wearing uniform and badge. I don hear phones dey ring for my head since you talk "chatbot" — I dey imagine anything from ₦150k to ₦300k for something wey go just handle WhatsApp/Instagram Q&A well, no calendar, no calls yet. If e go pass that reach ₦500k-₦600k, na there I go need sit down first, maybe even negotiate installment payment sha, because I sabi how these tech people dey price things — everything na "custom" and "scope" until bill land like ceramic coating for big SUV! 😏

So tell your team: Tunde na serious customer, but Tunde no be bank o — make dem come reasonable, and if dem give me correct number, God don butter my bread, we go start immediately!
Birdie

Ha, you got me there, oga — fair point, no double standard, I hear you 😂. I've written your numbers down clearly for the team, timeline and budget both, they'll take it from there.
